Name: Facelift Style Lamoids
Author: emjess
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Modified sprites of my alpacas (which are modifications of siamance's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] sheep) plus llamas! [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Has all the default and optional skins from Mizu's Alpaca and Llama with babies, plus config options to replace the blue llama and pink alpaca with black and patched black and white versions. I even threw in a quick pushmi-pullyu![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Installation: [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Pop it into your mods folder![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Credits: [/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Siamece[/url] for the original sheep sprites and a few bits and pieces I frankenstiened together
Mizu for the original and obviously required [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47417]Mizu's Alpaca and Llama[/url]
